title: Stimulation of MHC class I binding receptors on decidual NK clones.
protocol: Perform _in vitro_ culture and generation of IL-2 dNK clones as previously described.
Characterize NK clones for their expression of KIR2DS4, LIR-1, and KIR2DL1 receptors.
Select clones that are positive for only one of these receptors for co-incubation experiments.
Among EB6-positive clones, select only the clones on which functional expression of KIR2DL1 was verified by inhibition of killing Cw4 and Cw6 transfected 721.221 target cells.

Co-culture 30 X 10^3 dNK cells per well from each clone with an equal amount of different irradiated 721.221 transfectant cells for 72 hours at 37°C in a 5% CO₂ environment using Bio-MPM-1 medium supplemented with 5% pen-strep and non-essential amino acids.
Measure produced cytokines by ELISA after the co-culturing period.
